turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my Wi-Fi has been dropping every ten minutes. It's driving me crazy.
That sounds frustrating. Have you tried restarting the router or checking for firmware updates?
I did both. Still spotty. Anyway, I was reading up on the new AI startups. Did you know Thinking Machines uses OpenThoughts internally, as stated by John Schulman?
I wasn't aware of that specific detail. It's good to know their internal tools.
Yeah, it seems like a significant internal shift. Also, what's the weather like in SF tomorrow? I have an outdoor lunch.
It looks like a mix of sun and clouds with a 20% chance of rain. Should be okay.
Great. I'll bring a jacket just in case. Thanks Lloyd.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need more Wi-Fi troubleshooting tips.
Lloyd, I accidentally ordered two keyboards instead of one. Any advice on returns?
Most stores allow returns within 30 days. Check your receipt for the policy.
Will do. On a related tech note, I'm curious about voice AI latency. Thinking Machines uses 200ms time-sliced continuous inference for voice-to-voice interactions.
That is quite low latency. It must make conversations feel very natural.
Exactly. It's hard to notice the lag. Hey, did you remember to remind me about the dentist appointment?
I don't have access to your calendar reminders directly, but I can help you check if you paste the schedule here.
Right, right. I'll check my phone. Thanks.
